title: Today's top defense-tech headlines
big: 50 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: drones & air autonomy and allies & theaters.

stories.h: Shield AI software lets Taiwan drone boats shadow intruder
stories.what: Shield AI has released new details on how its Hivemind autonomy software steered two Taiwanese uncrewed boats through a joint patrol off southern Taiwan, fusing radar and ship-tracking data into a single picture and switching the pair from patrol to escort…
stories.you: Software that decides what to look at and what to hit is where the most value is moving.

stories.h: Japan Wants to Sell Air Defense, Maritime Surveillance Systems to Philippine Forces
stories.what: MANILA, Philippines — Japan wants to sell air defense, maritime surveillance and counter-drone systems to the Philippines amid its push to bolster forces in the South China Sea and Luzon Strait.
stories.you: The Navy is short of ships and is turning to cheaper unmanned boats, which opens the door to new builders.

stories.h: Taiwan buys three years of support for MQ-9B drones
stories.what: Taiwan is paying General Atomics Aeronautical Systems $38.8 million to keep its new MQ-9B SkyGuardian drones flying, under a contractor logistics support deal that runs through August 2029, the U.S. Department of War said. The award, announced on Oct.
stories.you: Drones are becoming the military's default purchase, so volume, price and reliability decide who wins.

stories.h: Lockheed invests $300M in Texas plant to feed missile surge
stories.what: Lockheed is investing $300 million to expand its Grand Prairie, Texas, plant, which supports all programs within its Missiles and Fire Control business.
stories.you: Weapons stockpiles are short, so anyone who can make missiles and rocket motors faster and cheaper has buyers.

stories.h: UK scraps three planned Boxer variants after budget cut
stories.what: The British Army has dropped plans for armored mortar, repair and recovery, and anti-tank overwatch versions of its Boxer wheeled armored vehicle, and has ruled out using Boxer in the armored cavalry role, Defence Minister Luke Pollard told Parliament.
stories.you: Budget and policy moves decide which programs get real money and when; they're the earliest signal of demand.

watch.why: Around November 3. Whether US commercial growth keeps outpacing government revenue.

idea.why: An autonomous interceptor under $5k for Shahed-class and FPV drones. Ukraine proved the concept, and Japan, the Gulf and US bases are buying. The cost-exchange crisis is acute.
